reviews.fs-composing-a-lebesgue-measurable-funct: The final Sol adjudicator rechecked the repaired witness using the trace Lebesgue sigma-algebras on [0,1] and [0,2]. The continuous inverse Cantor homeomorphism f:[0,2]→[0,1] pulls the Lebesgue-measurable set E back to the chosen nonmeasurable subset N, while g=1_E is correctly typed on [0,1]. Thus (g∘f)^{-1}((1/2,∞))=N is outside the domain trace sigma-algebra. The use of Choice to select N is explicit in the cited dependency, and the repaired counterexample is approved as final.
